reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent static review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP (retail PE view_1), radare2 6.2.0 CFG and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast on retail igi.exe; candidate source read from this worktree. No game process was executed and no runtime behavior is claimed.
review_basis: Retail 0x00407F50 was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view, independently recovered with radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast. The candidate is scripts/GameNatives/define/00407F50-DefineGameMaterial.cpp at sha256 45b8ac411405d666be6f824b06b1542cdfcd598c4baef26b8d854675df241ed3 (recorded implementation.signature: int32_t DefineGameMaterial(long param_1, long param_2, long param_3, long param_4, int32_t param_5, float param_6);). The evidence artifact digests are bound in this review.

candidate_comparison.statement: Divergences are listed above; by contract they keep the record at TRANSCRIBED or lower.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.detail: Retail entry 0x00407F50 is recovered by all three tools; the address-bound implementation is scripts/GameNatives/define/00407F50-DefineGameMaterial.cpp (sha256 45b8ac411405d666be6f824b06b1542cdfcd598c4baef26b8d854675df241ed3). Twelve blocks 0x407F50-0x4082xx: parses the material name and per-slot fields, calls Sys_ResolveSymbol_23/Profile_ValueSet/Script_EvalArgInt, allocates with 0x004B0C60, writes g_5C89FC-indexed records at 0x00569250..0x00569474 and stores 1 to 0x00A96AE0, then memcpy's the 0x18-byte return record.

checks.name: abi_and_signature
checks.detail: BN records (long double arg1, long double arg2, long double arg3, long double arg4, int32_t arg5, float arg6 @ 0xc): four x87 inputs, a stack result buffer and a [E+0xc] frame. The candidate (long,long,long,long,int,float) shifts the stack words and never binds the x87 values.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.detail: BN records (long double arg1, long double arg2, long double arg3, long double arg4, int32_t arg5, float arg6 @ 0xc): four x87 inputs, a stack result buffer and a [E+0xc] frame. The candidate (long,long,long,long,int,float) shifts the stack words and never binds the x87 values.

checks.name: control_flow_shape
checks.detail: Retail CFG: Binary Ninja reports 12 block(s)/16 edge(s) at 0x00407F50; radare2 recovers the identical 12 block(s)/16 edge(s) (score 1.0000); angr CFGFast recovers 33 block(s) with has_unresolved_jumps=False.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.detail: Retail's 12 Sys_ResolveSymbol_23 calls, 4 Profile_ValueSet calls, 3 Script_EvalArgInt calls and the two 0x004B0C60 allocations are present in name but not with the retail argument words because the stack layout is shifted; indirect call slots (eax/dword) are transcribed without their retail targets.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.detail: Material record stride 0x4A8, slots 0x20/0x100; return record 0x18; global 0x00A96AE0 set to 1; g_5C89FC index.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.detail: The g_5C89FC*0x4A8 record writes use the right offsets but the candidate's void*/long arithmetic in places changes the store widths; the result record destination is a shifted stack word.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.detail: Returns arg5/result word, not the retail [E+4] result pointer.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.detail: Retail consumes four x87 values (with fstp stores); the candidate passes stack longs and does not model st0-st3.

signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja reports "int32_t(long double arg1 @ st0, long double arg2 @ st1, long double arg3 @ st2, long double arg4 @ st3, int32_t arg5, float arg6 @ 0xc)" at 0x00407F50; radare2 recovers "fcn.00407f50 (int32_t arg_28h, int32_t arg_30h);". Both tools place the entry at 0x00407F50 and agree on the stack/register word count and cleanup; the difference is the level of type/argument-name detail, not the call frame. Candidate declaration: int32_t DefineGameMaterial(long param_1, long param_2, long param_3, long param_4, int32_t param_5, float param_6);. The candidate declaration is separately recorded as divergent below and does not satisfy the retail ABI.
